Sweet Apple Compote Song

[Verse 1]
In grandmother's kitchen at harvest time,
Apples red and golden shine,
With sugar sweet and cinnamon spice,
Making compote, oh so nice!

[Chorus]
Bubble, bubble, sweet compote,
Memories in every note,
Stir the pot with love and care,
Joy and sweetness everywhere!

[Verse 2]
From the orchard fresh we bring,
Autumn's bounty makes us sing,
Slice them thin with gentle hands,
As tradition understands.

[Chorus]
Bubble, bubble, sweet compote,
Memories in every note,
Stir the pot with love and care,
Joy and sweetness everywhere!

[Verse 3]
In glass jars we'll store away,
Winter's comfort, summer's day,
Family gathered, hearts so warm,
Following our age-old form.

[Chorus]
Bubble, bubble, sweet compote,
Memories in every note,
Stir the pot with love and care,
Joy and sweetness everywhere!
